for_supply_trace.title: Senior Frontend (React/Next.js) for Open-Access Supply Chains
for_supply_trace.description: Frontend architecture in React/Next.js + TypeScript; accessible, global UX for diverse users; collaboration with a Python/FastAPI backend; modern CSS with performance and reliability in mind; familiarity with Docker/Terraform/GCP.

sections.heading:
Full-stack architecture for
ever-growing teams
sections.subheading:
React/Next.js + TypeScript, modern CSS, and inclusive design to turn
 complex data into clear, actionable interfaces.

items.title: React/Next.js Architecture
items.text: SSR/ISR routing, data-fetching patterns, performance budgets, and design-system integration for rapid, reliable product delivery.

items.title: Accessible, Global UI
items.text: WCAG-compliant semantics, keyboard/focus/ARIA patterns, localization & RTL support so NGOs and clients can succeed anywhere.

items.title: APIs & Platform Integration
items.text: Tight API integrations and GCP services; CI/CD with Docker/Terraform to keep releases predictable.

dataviz.title: Data Visualization & Maps
dataviz.description: D3 and SVG-first visualizations: maps, centerline labels, and interaction that stays legible.

sections.heading: Readable, interactive dataviz
sections.subheading: Choropleths, centerline labeling, and zoomable maps using D3 v7 + SVG.

items.title: Centerline labels
items.text: Curved labels inside shapes; centroid fallback and truncation.

items.title: Lean stack
items.text: Vite + ES modules, D3 v7, and plain CSS.

ui-dev.title: UI Development & Prototyping
ui-dev.description: Production quality React + Joy UI components, quick modals, and data-first layouts.

sections.heading: Interfaces with momentum
sections.subheading: Fast iteration with component registries, data-driven rendering, and accessible defaults.

items.title: Data-first
items.text: Content JSON drives pages; one deploy updates many routes.

items.text: Block registry maps schema -> components; defaults keep it lean.

items.title: A11y by default
